I can't tell you the exact `just` command from this checkout. There's no justfile here, and the Makefile is still present on `main`, so the removal hasn't landed in this branch. `just` also isn't installed in my environment, so I couldn't run `just --list`.

The old fast target was:

```
pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```

That filter is probably wrong for the current tests. The only marker in `tests/` is `@pytest.mark.integration` (in `tests/test_payments.py`). Nothing is marked `postgres`, so `-m "not postgres"` would deselect nothing. Markers also aren't registered in `pyproject.toml`.

What I'd run for the fast tests:

```
pytest -m "not integration" -q
```

If your justfile defines a recipe for this, probably `just test-fast`, run `just --list` to confirm the name. If you point me at the justfile, I'll check it.
